purpose: Issue one append-only sealed successor to the v1 fixture authority and v2 owner-path correction after the real 1440 CUA observation found that the canonical shell scope query was rejected before DATA evaluation. This successor authorizes only the exact scope-query compatibility correction, exact fixture counter semantics correction, matching targeted tests, and one execution of each existing five-row Chromium browser-gate scenario. It does not activate or enroll a tenant, authorize customer or production data, enable a writable action, or close HRM-009, Batch-03, or R7.

v3OverridesOnly: production scope-query compatibility at the HRM-009 route-state boundary
fixture unexpected-evaluation and forwarded-request counter semantics
the browser driver assignment for the existing five-row matrix

actualCuaObservation.rootCause: The canonical shell emitted the exact trusted PAGE scope as the scalar scope query, but parseHrm009RouteState did not include scope in its allowedKeys set. The route therefore failed closed before the DATA authority request and People owner GET, even though the query scope and trusted PAGE decision scope were equal.
actualCuaObservation.interpretation: The zero DATA and GET counts are evidence of a production route-state compatibility gap, not evidence that the DATA or owner projection contracts are absent and not permission to weaken PAGE, DATA, scope, or read-only trust checks.

correctionAProductionScopeQueryCompatibi.authorizedBehaviorChange: Accept the canonical scope query at the HRM-009 route-state boundary only when it is a well-formed scalar public id and, when present, exactly equals the already trusted PAGE decision scope before any DATA evaluation can begin.
requiredTests: canonical scalar scope:hrm009:self is parsed and can proceed only with the exact PAGE decision scope
a foreign but syntactically valid scope fails closed before DATA evaluation
blank or whitespace-padded scope fails closed
a malformed public id fails closed
existing tab, focus, navigationScope and legalEntityPublicId validation remains unchanged

failClosedCasesThatIncrementUnexpectedAu: empty body or missing or blank routeContractKey
body larger than the bounded evaluation limit
an exact synthetic HRM-009 key whose subject, product, surface or requested scope violates its sealed contract

forwardedRequestCounterContract.attemptedMeaning: Increment immediately before creating the pinned upstream request.
forwardedRequestCounterContract.succeededMeaning: Increment only after the pinned upstream returns an HTTP status from 200 through 299 for the same classified request.
forwardedRequestCounterContract.evidenceAssertion: Browser-gate success requires succeeded authLogin, authMe and ordinaryApi counters to be positive; attempt counters alone cannot satisfy live-forward evidence.
forwardedRequestCounterContract.classificationStability: The same request contributes to total and exactly one applicable authLogin, authMe or ordinaryApi bucket under both attempted and succeeded groups.

secretHandling.permittedLogData: bounded route keys, methods, canonical paths, counter classes, reason codes, status classes and monotonic sequence only

correctionBFixtureAndEvidenceCounters.requiredSpecAdjustment: Update only the dedicated HRM-009 browser-gate spec types and assertions to the corrected unexpected-evaluation and attempted-versus-succeeded counter contract.
